report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 77ms, zero dependency timeouts, zero db pool waiters, OK traces and 200 logs. This contradicts the alert and supports no bounded root-cause candidate. Downstream services in the checkout path were not observed, so the fault cannot be localized; hand off for broader evidence.
missing_evidence: Telemetry from order, payment, inventory, redis, and postgresql services during the alert window
Error-rate and latency time series showing when the alert threshold was breached
Logs or traces containing actual error responses (non-200) during the incident
Deployment records for services in the checkout path around the alert window
